channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-06
item.description: “The darker the night, the brighter the stars.” — Fyodor Dostoevsky

item.title: Thich Nhat Hanh — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-05
item.description: “Life is available only in the present moment.” — Thich Nhat Hanh

item.title: Epictetus — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-04
item.description: “Keep silence for the most part, and speak only when you must, and then briefly.” — Epictetus

item.title: Gautama Buddha — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-03
item.description: “The mind is everything. What you think you become.” — Gautama Buddha

item.title: Confucius — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-02
item.description: “By nature, men are nearly alike; by practice, they get to be wide apart.” — Confucius

item.title: Mahatma Gandhi — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-01
item.description: “It is health that is real wealth and not pieces of gold and silver.” — Mahatma Gandhi

item.title: Victor Hugo — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-31
item.description: “To love or have loved, that is enough.” — Victor Hugo

item.title: William Londen — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-30
item.description: “To ensure good health: eat lightly, breathe deeply, live moderately, cultivate cheerfulness, and maintain an interest in life.” — William Londen
